Container.Name: Batchroom
Container.Overview: Self-hosted AI media processing: batch background removal, resizing, format conversion and marketplace preset packs. No meters, no quotas — images never leave your server. Web UI in 10 languages, REST API, watch folders. AI models download once (checksum-verified) into appdata.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: State: models, queue database, job outputs

Config.Name: Output
Config.Description: Optional output target for watch-folder jobs

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Set to require an API key for the UI/API (recommended when exposed beyond localhost)

Config.Name: Workers
Config.Description: Parallel image workers (raise on strong CPUs)
